text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
—Ah, I left it on airplane mode. How long 
has it been like that?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, the second I turn it off, 
notifications start flooding in... 
............

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Well, whatever. If it's something 
important, they'll contact me directly.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
So, if there's someone you want to see, 
you just have to go see them yourself.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: At any rate, only if I feel like it.
